profile: Stock PostgreSQL 16.6 and 17.2 with UTF-8, standard-conforming strings, stock local schemas and native parameters. An explicitly supplied current database name is compared exactly, after identifier decoding.
scope: Qualifiers on relation inputs, projected scalar columns and qualified stars, and on local relation targets that already support the corresponding operation. A database qualifier must be checked before the resolved schema and object are produced.
rules: A database qualifier can identify the local database only when the caller supplies its exact decoded name. An unknown or different name is rejected before any value is published.

Use the native ordered schema lookup for a bare relation and preserve its resolved absolute schema and relation. A verified current-database qualifier can be omitted in the output under the same external interpretation.
Preserve unrelated names and values, including dots inside quoted schema or relation names. Inspect decoded name roles as opposed to the original SQL spelling.
The supplied current database is a binding fact. The complete IR retains its resolved local references and does not retain the analysis context.
observations: Same absolute schema and relation slot for local, schema-qualified and verified current-database spellings.
Result name and ordered native integer rows of an independent decoy fixture.
Native read or effect on the selected local table and materialized snapshot and an unchanged decoy.
SQLSTATE 0A000 for a mismatched native catalog with no local modification. Typed refusal at the local binding boundary for unknown and mismatched catalogs.

finite.identity: Observe all 24 analyzed coordinates using paired native original and rendered SQL. The underlying direct concrete formats retain their separately registered constructor domains.

exploration.domain: Vary local role, current-database spelling, distinct source and decoy rows, quoted names containing dots, schema precedence and typed values.

trust: The supplied current database and declarations describe the same external namespace during comparison.
The checked decoded roles and exact common PHP publication boundary preserve qualifiers until validation.
Stock native observer and independently scheduled observations for the stated finite names and read and write effects.
open: Database-qualified forms of structurally distinct names, functions, types and other grammar alternatives remain governed by their individual role contracts.
Native acceptance in the absence of a declared current database cannot establish a portable absolute binding.
